positive_snippets: Had a great stay at Hotel Orbit Haveli (OYO) in Narela. The room was clean, spacious, and exactly like the photos. Staff was polite and helpful, and check-in was smooth. The place has a nice traditional vibe but feels modern and comfy. Food was decent and the location is easy to reach. Great value for money – would definitely stay again!
This hotel was nice. Staff and service were good. But the location wasn't cool for night, it's gives you spooky type feeling because of dark outside.
negative_snippets: Clean, cozy hotel, friendly staff, great spot. Wi-Fi fast, breakfast average. Minor noise issue, but four-star experience. Will return!
